title: Higurashi WHEN THEY CRY: Time Killing Arc
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 1978, Tokyo detective Mamoru Akasaka is sent to the rural village of Hinamizawa, where locals are protesting a dam project, to investigate the kidnapping of the construction minister's grandson, even though his wife is about to give birth. Posing as a tourist, he befriends Rika Furude, a shrine girl said to be the reincarnation of the local deity Oyashiro-sama, who warns him to leave. The two-volume arc opens with a brutal murder in 1985 (Yen Press blurb via MU; Otaku USA review).
life_message: Heeding warnings and putting family first matters more than duty when a closed community hides its dangers.
